_comment: Copy to store.config.json (beside sources.yaml) to override defaults. Every key is optional; delete a key to fall back to its default. store.config.json itself is gitignored; never commit it.

tech_updates_root._doc: Data root for ALL pipeline output (runs/, runs/sources/, findings/, log.md, watchlist.md). Must point at an EXISTING directory when set. Overrides the default. The TECH_UPDATES_ROOT env var wins over this key.
tech_updates_root.default: <project>/tech-updates (the project code folder's own tech-updates/ subdir)
